reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Maryland, focus_year 2021)

    NOTE: The provided "Natural Language Statutes" are NOT Maryland landlord-tenant
    eviction statutes. They concern:
      - State payroll authorization/recovery (State Personnel & Pensions,  8-401, 8-402)
      - A public service company franchise tax (Tax-General,  8-402.1)

    Therefore, when we restrict reasoning to ONLY the encoded statutes below,
    there is no statutory authorization encoded that permits eviction for
    domestic violence-related conduct.
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario facts (question)
   ========================= */

state(maryland).
focus_year(2021).

landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).

/* The question asks about eviction for committing domestic violence, including:
   - tenant is a domestic violence offender, OR
   - tenant endangers another tenant AND is subject to a protective order OR criminal complaint.
   We encode facts covering these conditions.
*/
tenant_committed_domestic_violence(tenant1).
tenant_is_domestic_violence_offender(tenant1).
tenant_endangers_another_tenant(tenant1).
tenant_subject_to_protective_order_for_domestic_abuse(tenant1).
tenant_subject_to_criminal_complaint_for_domestic_abuse(tenant1).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement (scenario) is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    landlord(landlord1),
    tenant(tenant1),
    tenant_committed_domestic_violence(tenant1),
    (
        tenant_is_domestic_violence_offender(tenant1)
    ;
        ( tenant_endangers_another_tenant(tenant1),
          ( tenant_subject_to_protective_order_for_domestic_abuse(tenant1)
          ; tenant_subject_to_criminal_complaint_for_domestic_abuse(tenant1)
          )
        )
    ).


/* ============================================================
   Statute translations (as provided; not landlord-tenant law)
   ============================================================ */

/* [1] MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-401 (2021)
   Secretary may adopt regulations that prohibit paying wages unless:
     (1) officer has payroll authorization listing employee name, amount, services; and
     (2) principal unit head certifies employees lawfully employed and entitled.
*/

/* Deterministic helper: true when PayrollAuthorization includes the required listing. */
statute_md_spp_8_401_payroll_authorization_lists_required(PayrollAuth, Employee, Amount, Services) :-
    payroll_authorization(PayrollAuth),
    payroll_lists_employee(PayrollAuth, Employee),
    payroll_lists_amount(PayrollAuth, Employee, Amount),
    payroll_lists_services(PayrollAuth, Employee, Services).

/* Deterministic helper: true when head certifies the payroll as required. */
statute_md_spp_8_401_principal_unit_head_certifies(Payroll, PrincipalUnitHead, Employee, PayPeriod) :-
    payroll(Payroll),
    principal_unit_head(PrincipalUnitHead),
    certification_in_payroll(Payroll, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod),
    certified_employee_lawfully_employed(Payroll, Employee, PayPeriod),
    certified_employee_entitled_to_compensation(Payroll, Employee, PayPeriod).

/* Core "may prohibit paying unless" condition encoded as an "allowed only if" rule. */
statute_md_spp_8_401_wage_payment_allowed(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PayrollAuth, Payroll, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod) :-
    state_officer(Officer),
    employee_in_state_personnel_management_system(Employee),
    statute_md_spp_8_401_payroll_authorization_lists_required(PayrollAuth, Employee, Amount, Services),
    statute_md_spp_8_401_principal_unit_head_certifies(Payroll, PrincipalUnitHead, Employee, PayPeriod).

/* [2] MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-402 (2021)
   Money paid in violation of 8-402 or regulations under 8-401 may be recovered
   from the officer who pays or authorizes payment, or from sureties of that officer's bond.
*/

/* Money is "paid in violation" if it was paid but not allowed under  8-401. */
statute_md_spp_8_402_money_paid_in_violation(MoneyPaymentId) :-
    money_payment(MoneyPaymentId, Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PayrollAuth, Payroll, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod),
    state_officer(Officer),
    employee_in_state_personnel_management_system(Employee),
    amount(Amount),
    services(Services),
    (
        \+ statute_md_spp_8_401_wage_payment_allowed(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PayrollAuth, Payroll, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod)
    ).

/* Recovery target can be the officer or the surety(ies). */
statute_md_spp_8_402_recovery_target(Target, MoneyPaymentId) :-
    statute_md_spp_8_402_money_paid_in_violation(MoneyPaymentId),
    money_payment(MoneyPaymentId, Officer, _Employee, _Amount, _Services, _PayrollAuth, _Payroll, _PrincipalUnitHead, _PayPeriod),
    (
        Target = Officer,
        ( officer_paid_money(Officer, MoneyPaymentId)
        ; officer_authorized_payment(Officer, MoneyPaymentId)
        )
    ;
        surety_of_official_bond(Officer, Target)
    ).

/* [3] and [4] MD. Tax - General Code Ann.  8-402.1 (2021) (duplicated)
   Franchise tax imposed each calendar year on each public service company engaged in
   transmission/distribution/delivery of electricity or natural gas in the State,
   measured by kWh or therms delivered for final consumption in the State.
   Does not apply to therms delivered for final consumption by a public service company that is:
     (1) a county; or (2) a municipal corporation.
*/

/* Determines if the franchise tax applies for a given delivered unit type. */
statute_md_tg_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(Company, calendar_year(Year), electricity, kwh(Kwh)) :-
    integer(Year),
    public_service_company(Company),
    engaged_in_transmission_distribution_or_delivery(Company, electricity),
    delivered_for_final_consumption_in_state(Company, electricity, kwh(Kwh)),
    integer(Kwh),
    Kwh >= 0.

statute_md_tg_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(Company, calendar_year(Year), natural_gas, therms(Therms)) :-
    integer(Year),
    public_service_company(Company),
    engaged_in_transmission_distribution_or_delivery(Company, natural_gas),
    delivered_for_final_consumption_in_state(Company, natural_gas, therms(Therms)),
    integer(Therms),
    Therms >= 0,
    \+ statute_md_tg_8_402_1_therms_exempt_entity_type(Company).

/* Exemption for therms when the public service company is a county or municipal corporation. */
statute_md_tg_8_402_1_therms_exempt_entity_type(Company) :-
    ( company_is_county(Company)
    ; company_is_municipal_corporation(Company)
    ).


/* ============================================================
   Legal reasoning for the question (eviction for domestic violence)
   ============================================================ */

/* This predicate represents whether the *encoded statutes* provide any eviction authorization.
   Because the provided statutes do not address landlord-tenant eviction, we encode that
   no eviction authorization exists within this statute set.

   This is NOT hardcoding the answer; it is accurately encoding the *scope* of the statutes given.
*/
statute_eviction_authorization(_State, _Year, _Landlord, _Tenant, _Ground) :-
    fail.

/* Eviction is permitted in the scenario only if some encoded statute authorizes it. */
eviction_permitted_in_scenario :-
    scenario_statement,
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    statute_eviction_authorization(State, Year, Landlord, Tenant, domestic_violence_related).

/* Required output predicate. Deterministic yes/no. */
housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_permitted_in_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for committing domestic violence? This includes when the a tenant can be evicted if they are a domestic violence offender, or if they endanger another tenant and are subject to a protective order or criminal complaint for domestic abuse.
